authority: TASKS.md S56 section, commit 9c88d89d (step 3 v3 active)
failure_policy: Failure of any prediction is recorded, never re-run or tuned. A non-Optimal solve is recorded; then C_central is undefined and the step 4 smoke proceeds without it for 2025|Summer (Planner task, item 1). A guard-count mismatch or a harness exception is a harness fault: recorded, and the stage stops for the Planner.

gates_recorded.loaded_point_objective: pe.value(merged.objective) at the loaded point vs the saved merged-default objective: recorded (bitwise and relative); a failure is recorded, not a stop
gates_recorded.warm_source_hash: sha256 of the warm source == spec, before reading (refuse otherwise, zero solves)

instance_12_block.label: s56_srp1grid_3x3
instance_12_block.plan: x = 0 (no storage; combine_networks empties the shared ESS)
instance_12_block.scenarios: 3 market x 3 operation, omega_s = p_m * p_o

objective_convention: gross: step 3 model.objective (settlement weight 0, no row 18, no pin, no salvage), EUR per representative day; C_central probability-weighted

outputs.central: central_2025_Summer.json (C_central, parts, the central point interface P/Q/V per scenario and DN)

predecessor.relation: step 3 v2 + step 4 diagnostics spec (run_v1: S3-2 singles 12, 22 maxIter); this spec completes S3-2 with two warm single solves

predictions.S3v3_P2: each objective = the merged per-scenario term minus an offset in [0.030, 0.040] EUR;

predictions_operational.S3v3_P1: per single (12, 22): solution loaded (production solver_result_succeeded), termination 'optimal', IPOPT exit 'Optimal Solution Found.' (step 3 harness `optimal`)
predictions_operational.S3v3_P2: per single s: offset_s = (v2 run S3-2 merged_default costs.per_scenario[s].objective_per_scenario) - (single s objective); 0.030 <= offset_s <= 0.040
predictions_operational.S3v3_P3: C_central = sum_s omega_s C_s over the 9 singles of 2025|Summer (the v2 run S3-2 singles 00, 01, 02, 10, 11, 20, 21 + this stage's 12, 22; omega_s = the singles' recorded probability); P3: |S3-2 merged_warm - C_central| / |C_central| <= 1e-6; P4: |S3-2 merged_default - C_central| / |C_central| <= 1e-5; both must hold

recovery: off (step 3 configure; one attempt per solve)

solves.derivation: one Network.run_smopf per single (12, 22) through the step 3 harness _solve_one

stage: P5.15 S56 step 3 v3: 2025|Summer singles 12 and 22 warm from the saved merged-default slice; 2025|Summer C_central and step 3 P3 / P4 (frozen spec v3)
start: freshly built merged 2025|Summer model (step 3 build); every free Var set by name from the warm source (the v2 S3-2 merged-default primal values); then per single: sliced (step 3 slice_network), built (step 3 build), every free Var set from the loaded merged model at the same index with that scenario (positions from the declarations, as the v2 S3-1 mapping); no duals; from_warm_start=False

objective_alignment.source: the values the ADMM path sets on every TSO and DSO block: shared_resources_planning._prepare_transmission_objectives_for_admm / _prepare_distribution_objectives_for_admm (penalty_shared_ess_usage 0, penalty_gen_curtailment 0, cost_load_curtailment COST_CONSUMPTION_CURTAILMENT = 300); interface_settlement_weight is NOT set (stays 0; see audit)

step3_v1_settings_reused.objective_convention: gross: model.objective with interface_settlement_weight 0, no row 18 (alpha = 0), no voltage pin = generation + flexibility (P and Q down) + load-curtailment cost + slack terms (+ zero-weighted penalties); settlement excluded (none exists in the merged model); no terminal salvage (x = 0, no storage); EUR per representative day, probability-weighted over the 9 scenarios of the block. C_central(block) = sum_s omega_s C_s, C_s = single-scenario model.objective. The block weight in the planning sum (years[y] x days[d] / 1.02^(y - 2025), NetworkData.get_primal_value) is reported beside it, not applied.

pre_solve_gates.applies_to: both chosen blocks, before the first solve; any failure refuses the run with ZERO solves
list: probabilities, energy prices and flexibility prices identical across TN and every DN, every block
block-choice premise: every TN conventional generator has P_min = 0
per block: alpha = 0 (no row 18), no voltage pin, settlement weight 0 and value 0, no ADN / shared ESS
per block: 3 market x 3 operation scenarios
per block: no coupling -- every active constraint's free Vars carry one scenario label equal to its own index; no scenario-common or unresolvable Var/Constraint component

per block: slice identity at a seeded random point -- each of the 9 single models equals the merged model restricted to that scenario (constraint bodies, bounds, Var bounds and fixings, per-scenario objective expressions), and merged objective == sum omega single objective
every imported repo module committed clean; harness and spec committed clean; spec sha256 matches its name tag
capture checklist asserted before anything is read
no campaign lock, no other p5*.py python process, output directory absent, single-instance lock

reported.per_solve: termination condition, IPOPT exit text, iterations, wall time, peak RSS (sampled IPOPT child at 0.1 s and the exact running max ru_maxrss), objective and parts, max constraint violation, per-scenario interface P/Q/V per DN, curtailment
reported.relaxations: per DN: scenario-hours where the merged interface lies outside the dropped DN reference-generator P/Q limits, outside the DN reference-node voltage limits, or |P| above the interface rating R (the TSO's interface_delta box is +-R about its fixed pc in the ADMM path)

solver.call: Network.run_smopf(model, params, from_warm_start=False) for every solve, through the harness's _solve_one
solver.inherited_unchanged: every other TN case-file option (acceptable_tol 1e-4, acceptable_iter 5, bound_push/frac 1e-6, slack_bound_push/frac 1e-6, output_file, file_print_level 6); production pins fixed_variable_treatment and max_iter 500
solver.source: S55 central check rulings (spec 0e00f6a8): tol 1e-5, compl_inf_tol 1e-6, MA97, recovery off, one attempt
